recommendation: Do not push now. Push only after the owner has reviewed DECISIONS-RECOMMENDED.md and explicitly approved publishing the exact record at HEAD 4abb961aad98525ca8b992a24609a6286964a451. Immediately before pushing, refresh the origin tracking refs and verify that main is still a non-diverged fast-forward from origin/main; if HEAD or origin/main moved, re-audit the range. Then use a normal non-force push with no rebase or squash.
rationale: Claude's timing recommendation is sound, but its precondition is incomplete. The local bytes show exactly twelve commits after origin/main: eleven adopted D-282 through D-292 act commits plus the 9d04151 D-285 hygiene commit. Every act commit modifies COORD only by an end append and adds only files under docs/coop/artifacts; the hygiene commit performs exactly two date substitutions in COORD. The current cached origin/main is the parent of D-282 and is an ancestor of HEAD, so the present local graph is 0 behind and 12 ahead. That does not establish that the remote server will still have the same main tip when the later push occurs. Because pushing publishes external state and the current request expressly forbids pushing, explicit owner approval of the exact HEAD and a fresh fast-forward check are required. History must remain intact because D-286 artifacts pin and name 9d04151 as custody.

refutations.claim: git log 4881022~1..HEAD contains exactly twelve commits: D-282 through D-292 plus the D-285 hygiene commit.
refutations.evidence: git rev-list --count 4881022~1..HEAD returns 12. The reverse log is 4881022 D-282, 9eb56dc D-283, b8bc52a D-284, 791187b D-285, 9d04151 D-285 hygiene, 81c7657 D-286, 8e3db61 D-287, 8d0cf09 D-288, 63d1387 D-289, 20e6d2d D-290, cb8bd16 D-291, and 4abb961 D-292.

refutations.claim: Each of the eleven act commits contains only a COORD append plus newly frozen files under docs/coop/artifacts.
refutations.evidence: git show --stat and --name-status for the eleven act hashes show only M docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md and A docs/coop/artifacts/*, with no unexpected path. COORD numstat is additions-only in every act, and each zero-context diff has one insertion hunk at the prior end of file.

refutations.claim: The eleven recorded acts are adopted after dual CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX.
refutations.evidence: The Status paragraph under each COORD heading D-282 through D-292 says ADOPTED, CONSENT from both independent reviewers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX; D-282, D-283, D-284, and D-292 reached that state on later permitted turns, while the other seven did so on turn 1.

refutations.claim: 9d04151 is the only non-append change in the twelve-commit range and changes only two D-285 date lines in COORD.
refutations.evidence: git show 9d04151 reports one file changed, 2 insertions and 2 deletions. Its sole hunk replaces D-285 Date and ADOPTED 2026-08-26 with 2026-08-27. Commit 791187b and hygiene commit 9d04151 were both authored and committed on 2026-08-27.

refutations.claim: Rebasing or squashing the range would preserve the recorded custody bytes.
refutations.evidence: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-286.draft.md and exact-bytes-leftover-join.v7.json pin the full 9d041513b1e499038b2de488203c698754220417 hash and describe it as D-285 hygiene custody. Rewriting the range would change the pinned commit identity.

refutations.claim: The current local origin/main tracking ref is exactly twelve commits behind HEAD with no divergence.
refutations.evidence: origin/main resolves to 078b3d6cd3105ee2bb3cde061ef09d1b530440a6, which is 4881022's parent. git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD returns 12, HEAD..origin/main returns 0, and git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD succeeds.

refutations.claim: The cached origin/main comparison proves that the remote server's main branch will still permit the later push.
refutations.evidence: origin/main is a local remote-tracking ref and no fetch was performed in this review. Its 0-behind/12-ahead graph proves the current local snapshot only; the remote may advance before the owner completes review.

refutations.claim: Pushing before owner review would matter only if another machine needed the record.
refutations.evidence: No repository byte establishes that exclusivity. A push also publishes the exact history to the shared remote and may trigger downstream consumers; more importantly, the owner has not yet accepted the recommendation packet and this request explicitly says not to push.

refutations.claim: The repository record establishes that no other machine or collaborator currently needs these commits.
refutations.evidence: The inspected commit range, COORD, and tracking graph contain no evidence about present external consumers. Absence of such a statement is not evidence that none exists.

amendments: Make the push preconditions explicit: obtain owner approval for the exact HEAD being published; immediately before the push refresh origin and require a non-diverged fast-forward graph; if either ref moved, re-audit; use a normal non-force push and preserve all twelve commit identities.
